answer: The finality of attestations only counts when the attestator is established, so a fresh cluster of aliases cannot push any transaction to finality until it has spent many epochs proving honesty. Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a nectar as the anchor of the cost.
